summary: The PR addresses the issue by optimizing the sequence of operations but introduces a new test file which was not expected based on the description.

issues.description: The PR includes a new test file `test_migration_optimization.py` which was not mentioned in the description and is not part of the expected changes. This could be considered scope creep.

The new test file does not follow the typical Django test structure and conventions. It uses a standalone function instead of a test class inheriting from `unittest.TestCase` or `django.test.TestCase`.
